description: This file defines a BatchGenerator class for data augmentation and batch creation in an object detection pipeline, specifically tailored for YOLOv3-like models. It handles image loading, augmentation, bounding box processing, and prepares training batches with multiple output scales.

classes.name: BatchGenerator
classes.description: A data generator class for object detection training, supporting image augmentation, multi-scale training, and batch preparation for YOLO models.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BatchGenerator with dataset instances, anchors, labels, and various augmentation parameters.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of batches per epoch.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Generates a batch of data, including images, ground truth boxes, and network outputs, with augmentation.

methods.name: _get_net_size
methods.description: Determines the input image size, changing every 10 batches for multi-scale training.

methods.name: _aug_image
methods.description: Performs image augmentation including scaling, cropping, color distortion, flipping, and bounding box correction.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Shuffles the dataset at the end of each epoch if shuffling is enabled.

methods.name: num_classes
methods.description: Returns the number of object classes.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of dataset instances.

methods.name: get_anchors
methods.description: Returns the list of anchor box dimensions.

methods.name: load_annotation
methods.description: Loads annotations (bounding boxes and labels) for a specific dataset instance.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Loads an image file for a specific dataset instance.
